questions: Should the target variable y be generated as sum of all five features plus noise, or as a different linear combination (e.g., weighted sum) of the features?
Is the random seed for the RandomForestRegressor set to the same random_seed parameter used for numpy random sampling, or should it be set independently?
Should the cross_val_score use the default scoring method (R²) or a specific scoring metric?
Does the function need to return the model trained on the full dataset, or the last fitted model from cross-validation?
Should the random numbers added to create the target be sampled from standard normal distribution independent of the features, or can they be correlated?
Is the cross-validation splitter in cross_val_score deterministic based on random_seed, or should it be left to default (non-deterministic)?
Should the function handle non-integer cv values (e.g., float) or only integer folds?
If cv > num_samples, should the function raise an error or proceed with leave-one-out CV?
